$Comment: The worn-gear rung: Orrin asks for the gear a player would otherwise throw away, the blades
chipped to nothing and the boots walked through, and a long sitting at the table to unmake
No objective kind reads a piece's wear, so the step counts PIECES rather than worn pieces:
STATION_INPUT with a blank Target (any item), qualified to 'Disenchanting_Table' on PREFIX so
both tiers count and the Sawmill does not, carrying the shared unmake_gear TextKey so the line
reads honestly as 'pieces of gear'. The worn-ness lives in Orrin's ask and in what a player
has to hand, not in the count: a piece near breaking pays the table less essence (its wear
scales the payout), so the player who follows the ask gets through the count at a lower wage
and a player who feeds it fresh gear pays more for the same count. No hand-in: with TurnInId
'giver' the quest still settles at Orrin. Rewards sit in Claim, Enchanting first and Crafting
half. Retune the one Amount to change how long the sitting runs.
Name: Worn_Through
